edit.description: KindRelocation gains kind and field guidance
a relocated built-in projects the guidance its relocation declares

summary: A relocated built-in carries the guidance its relocation declares into its path-scoped rule; the built-in's own shipped guidance never projects by default
acceptance: relocate(skill, { guidance }) emits a rule with that counsel over skill's locus; a bare import emits none; pnpm --dir sdk test green
notes: SDK-only. Per 0091: projecting built-ins' guidance by default was rejected; relocation is the opt-in.
